g.text: Confounders: Triton reads a B operand transposed before timing; cuTile tiles differ (256×256 on B200, 128×128 on GH200)

g.text: Triton and cuTile write the same 2.05 M store sectors on both devices; the PyTorch baseline (index_copy) differs by vendor
